messages:
Maya: Following up on the authz incident from yesterday — posting concrete action items and owners so we can close the loop. Short thread, please ack and add if I missed anything.

Maya: TL;DR: root cause = expired token handling + overly permissive fallback role. Recurring pattern: this is our 3rd perms-related lapse in ~6 months. Need both short-term fixes and a near-term policy change.

Jon: Ack. can we get a strict timeline for token validation fix?

Maya: Proposed timeline: quick patch to validation in 48h, end-to-end tests in 72h, rollout to prod canary 1 week.

Alex: I can take the validation patch + tests. Will submit PR today.

Alex: Quick snippet I'll implement for signature+expiry checks:```python
if not validate_signature(token):
    return 401
if token.exp < time.time():
    return 401
# explicitly reject tokens with deprecated algs
if token.alg in deprecated_algs:
    return 401
```

Sarah: I'll own secrets rotation for any compromised keys and coordinate with infra + customer success for notices. Target: rotation started within 24h, completed for all service accounts in 72h.

Priya: For audit logging: current logs miss per-request principal when we fallback to the role. I'll add structured fields: principal_id, effective_role, fallback_reason, token_id. ETA 5 days to ship and enable retention alerts.

Maya: Action item list (summary):
- Alex: Token validation patch + tests (48–72h).
- Priya: Audit log schema + retention alerts (5 days).
- Sarah: Secrets rotation + KMS audit (start 24h, complete 72h).
- Product/Security: Update fallback policy so we DO NOT auto-elevate when token validation fails — default deny (policy RFC in 7 days).
- Ops: Run a sweep to identify tokens still using deprecated algs, report back (48h).

Jon: For the policy RFC, who drafts? I can help.

Maya: Jon + Sarah to co-draft. Add me as reviewer. Due in 7 days.

IncBot: New ticket created: INC-2026 - "Auth Token Validation & Audit Follow-up" (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026) assigned to Alex, Priya, Sarah.

Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4582 — includes unit tests and a compatibility flag. Please review.

Priya: Quick note — we'll need a small schema migration for logs, I'll coordinate with eng-infra to avoid retention gaps.

Sarah: Rotation plan: I'll rotate service account keys first, then app secrets. I'll post rotation windows in #release-war-room.

Maya: Recurring incident pattern note: ops telemetry shows ~3x spike in fallback-role use during deploy windows. Possible race with new deployments not loading updated keysets. Devs: please ensure key rotation hooks are part of deploy checklist.

Jon: Suggest adding a synthetic test that validates token parse & signature on each deploy. Could be part of canary gating.

Alex: Agree — I'll add a lightweight check to the deploy pipeline.

Maya: Ok — please ack each assigned item in this thread once you start. We'll track progress in INC-2026 and reconvene in 48h for status.

Alex: ack — starting now.

Priya: ack — starting audit schema draft.

Sarah: ack — rotation plan posted, starting 2pm UTC.

Jon: ack — drafting policy RFC.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll put a short blameless note into the postmortem doc and link INC-2026.

Priya: Quick question — do we want to add token algorithm deprecation enforcement to the SDK as well? Might reduce client incidents.

Maya: Good call. Alex, can you add an SDK validation ticket to the PR?

Alex: Yep, adding now. Ticket link in PR.

IncBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up status check in 48h.

Maya: Closing thread for now — we will update INC-2026 and the postmortem with concrete dates. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
